eventName: Sixth Year One lakh Palm seed planting ceremony  ONE LAKH PALM SEED PLANTATION FESTIVAL- Seventh Phase Fieldwork
eventDescription:
Vidhaigal Organization, in association with NSS students from Sairam College and SRM College, planted 10,000 palm seeds along the Adyar Canal stretch between Mudichur and Varadharajapuram.
This region faces severe damage every year due to natural disasters and flooding. We hope that the palm seeds planted today will grow into strong trees and eventually become a protective green barrier for both nature and the local community.
